title: round (server to device)
description: The latest published round, after `welcome` and whenever its `rev` changes or a newer round is published. A round taken back is never sent.

results.description: Optional. Same as `tournament.results` in `welcome`: the tournament's public front page on the results site, or null when it is not public. Sent with every round so that a device that missed the welcome (or a tournament that went public later) catches up.
